column4: A Woman's Guide to Understanding Endometriosis, Calming Inflammation, and Living Beyond the Pain
column12: Endometriosis affects one in ten women, yet it remains one of the most misunderstood conditions in women's health. The Body Unbound is the practical guide that cuts through the confusion — explaining what endometriosis actually is (it's not just "bad periods"), how to get a diagnosis that's been delayed for years, what treatment options really work (with honest pros and cons), and how to build a full life around this condition. Written by a health writer who has been through it, this is the book that tells you what your doctor didn't have time to.

column4: A Woman's Guide to ADHD, Spirituality, and Finding Peace in a Busy Brain
column12: If you have an ADHD brain and have ever tried to meditate, pray, or sit still in spiritual practice — and felt like a failure — this book is for you. The Restless Soul bridges the gap between the neurodivergent mind and the spiritual life, offering a radically different approach: instead of trying to fix your brain to fit spiritual advice, it reimagines spiritual practice for the brain you actually have.
